jobs.occupation: Build a Lasting Radiology Career in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in radiology looking for a new professional opportunity in Sweden? 
Dignus Medical collaborates with hospitals and imaging departments across the country and can offer a broad range of permanent positions within diagnostic radiology.
We are currently seeking EU-certified radiologists for long-term roles in Sweden.
Our network includes both smaller regional hospitals and larger hospital settings, allowing us to match your experience and preferences with suitable workplaces.
As a radiologist, you will work with diagnostic imaging as part of a multidisciplinary clinical team. 
Positions are available within general radiology, and subspecialist experience is welcome but not required. 
The exact scope of work will depend on your background and the needs of the department.
What Dignus Medical Offers You:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with Swedish authorization and specialist recognition, if required
Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for accompanying family members
Access to a free Swedish language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Qualifications:
EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish

Interested in new opportunities in radiology?
Contact us to discuss available positions and find a role that fits your professional profile.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

We are looking for a Data Scientist who is passionate about leveraging data to drive commercial success in the gaming industry. In this role, you’ll focus on using analytics to identify growth opportunities, optimise game monetization strategies, support business development initiatives, and build scalable commercial tooling. You’ll partner with game designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to unlock data-driven insights that fuel our business growth and maximize player engagement.
Example of responsibilities 

Analyse game performance metrics and player data to identify business opportunities.

Provide insights and recommendations to optimise in-game economies, pricing models, and player engagement initiatives.

Collaborate with business development and product teams to develop data-driven monetization strategies.

Design, build, and maintain commercial tooling to empower commercial teams.

Build dashboards and reports to track business performance and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.

Utilize AI-assisted coding workflows to accelerate development.

We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind

Strong background in SQL

Experience in working with ETLs and data pipelines

Proficiency in Python for data modelling, analysis over large datasets, and script/tool building

Experience building tooling or interactive dashboards

Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools

Ability to communicate insights and strategies to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Experience or interest in games

Professional English communication skills.

Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology
Third-cycle subject area
Biology
Description of the doctoral project
 
The apical hook is a temporary organ structure that forms at the tip of the stem (hypocotyl) in darkness, aiding the germinating seedling as it emerges through the soil. Apical hook formation serves as an excellent model to study plant morphogenesis, as it involves distinct phases of growth promotion and inhibition. The phytohormone indole-3-acetic acid (IAA) is central to plant morphogenesis. This project focuses on investigating the modulation of auxin's spatiotemporal distribution in response to mechanochemical signals during development in Arabidopsis thaliana.
About the position
The research will utilize a range of approaches, including molecular biology techniques, cell biology methods (such as confocal and electron microscopy), mechncobiology experiments, physiological studies, proteomics, and genetic analysis.
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have:
been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification;
satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or
acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).
You must have equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.

You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
Your profile
The applicant should have a strong interest in plant biology, molecular plant biology, mechanobiology or related fields. A background in cell and molecular biology is essential. Previous experience or expertise in mechanobiology or plant cell wall biology would be considered an advantage.
The successful candidate should be highly motivated, driven and curious, with good interpersonal and communication skills. After an initial training period, they are expected to take increasing responsibility for their research, show initiative, and work independently, while continuing to receive guidance from their supervisor.
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English are essential.
Beyond academic qualifications, we place great importance on personal integrity, honesty, open communication and a collaborative attitude. We are looking for someone who is comfortable discussing both successes and difficulties, communicates openly about challenges and mistakes, takes responsibility for their work and contributes positively to a supportive and constructive research environment.
About us
The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.
Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee on https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ 
Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/

Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed.
Location:

100%

Upon agreement.

The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Ready to kick-start your career at the intersection of systems engineering, AI, and commercial business flows? On behalf of our client, a fast-growing, globally active Swedish medtech company, Academic Work is looking for a newly graduated engineer to automate and develop business-critical systems. With close mentorship from senior architects, you will quickly grow into a key role in an international environment based in central Stockholm. Apply today—we review applications on an ongoing basis!
About the role
Our client is a leading global MedTech company developing clinically researched, objective testing software for ADHD evaluation. Used by thousands of clinicians worldwide, their technology helps healthcare providers make faster, more accurate diagnoses and improve patient outcomes.
As a Junior Business System Integrations Engineer, you will join a tight-knit architecture team consisting of four employees. You will receive dedicated coaching and daily support from senior architects. Your main focus will be streamlining and automating internal processes through scripting, API integrations, and system configuration rather than traditional web or app development. Acting as a bridge between technology and business, you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders in Finance and Commercial, as well as maintain ongoing dialogue with external system vendors. The role is based at our client’s office near Humlegården in Stockholm, following a hybrid work model where you are expected to be on-site at least three days a week.
This is initially a 6-month consulting assignment through Academic Work, with great opportunities for long-term employment with our client thereafter
You are offered
A unique opportunity to build valuable experience within the regulated and expanding global medtech industry.
Close mentorship and continuous support from senior architects in a welcoming, low-prestige environment.
Hands-on experience working at the forefront of modern AI tools for code generation and system automation.
An international workplace collaborating across global markets, including the UK and the US.

Work tasks
This role focuses on backend development, business system integrations, and process automation rather than frontend or app development. You will work closely with internal teams to ensure data flows securely and efficiently across platforms.
Take technical ownership of the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of NetSuite and Salesforce.  
Build and maintain integrations between business systems, the data lake, and the AWS platform using REST APIs (JSON payloads) and AWS Lambdas.  
Automate manual workflows and commercial processes using Python and TypeScript scripts as well as low-code tools.  
Leverage modern AI coding assistants to accelerate development, focusing on reviewing, understanding, and ensuring the quality of generated code.  
Write and optimize database queries in SQL, SuiteQL, and SOQL to extract, validate, and reconcile business data.  
Collaborate closely with Finance and Commercial teams to translate business requirements (from quote-to-order and contracts to usage and billing) into concrete technical solutions.  
Ensure high data integrity, accurate numerical reconciliation, and strict compliance with data privacy and information security standards.  
Coordinate and communicate with external system suppliers regarding ongoing integrations and system updates.

We are looking for
A recently completed academic degree (M.Sc. or B.Sc.) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a related technical field.
A solid foundation in programming (such as Python, Java, or TypeScript) and the ability to quickly grasp system architecture and codebases.
A basic understanding of commercial and financial flows, including quote-to-order, contracts, invoicing, and usage-based billing.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken, as English is the corporate language (Swedish is not required, though you must hold a valid work permit for Sweden).

Prior experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or AWS is not required—what matters most is your technical foundation, business curiosity, and ability to learn quickly.
To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Business-minded and communicative: You enjoy interacting with people, feel comfortable initiating dialogue with colleagues and external vendors, and can turn vague requests into clear technical specifications.
Detail-oriented and quality-driven: You are meticulous with numbers, always double-check that data reconciles before handing it over, and respect the high standards of data privacy required in medtech.
Analytical problem-solver: You quickly understand cause and effect in complex environments and are motivated by building smart, automated solutions.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

🚀 We’re Hiring: Software Factory Business Analyst – System Engineering & CI/CD
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Software Factory Business Analyst / System Engineer
Specialisation: Requirements Engineering | Software Factory | Agile Transformation | CI/CD | System Architecture | Traceability
Seniority: Experienced / Senior-level
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Languages: Fluent Swedish and English (spoken and written)
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Software Factory Business Analyst to support the modernisation and continuous development of an advanced software development platform.
The role combines business analysis, requirements engineering, system architecture, product management, and software engineering processes. You will translate business objectives and customer needs into structured, measurable, and traceable requirements while ensuring technical and architectural decisions support both immediate delivery and long-term business goals.
You will collaborate with product managers, system engineers, software architects, and development teams to improve software development processes, CI/CD capabilities, verification, traceability, and performance measurement.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Analysis & Requirements Engineering
Translate business objectives and customer needs into structured, value-driven requirements.
Support product management with value propositions, prioritisation, and measurable success criteria.
Ensure requirements are testable, traceable, and aligned with business objectives.
Analyse business needs, technical constraints, and long-term development requirements.
Maintain reusable requirements documentation and engineering knowledge assets.

2. Software Factory & Agile Transformation
Support modernisation and continuous improvement of software development environments.
Drive the transition from traditional waterfall approaches to Agile ways of working.
Apply practical knowledge of Scrum and Agile product development.
Establish and improve Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) processes.
Support product ownership and backlog management for CI/CD and development platform improvements.
Encourage adoption of efficient engineering practices and modern development methods.

3. System Architecture & Technical Traceability
Collaborate with system engineers to evaluate technical and architectural alternatives.
Assess solutions against business needs, technical constraints, and long-term objectives.
Establish traceability between deployed systems, source code, tests, and engineering metrics.
Improve Software Factory processes, tools, and capabilities.
Evaluate architectural decisions relating to modularity, flexibility, technical debt, and future development.

4. Verification, Quality & Performance Measurement
Translate quality requirements into measurable acceptance criteria and quality gates.
Establish and maintain relevant KPIs, metrics, and dashboards.
Monitor development flow, software quality, and delivery predictability.
Support continuous follow-up of verification and engineering performance.
Ensure consistent application of verification strategies and quality processes.

5. Communication & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with product management, system engineering, architecture, and development teams.
Facilitate technical and business discussions and support decision-making.
Guide teams in adopting improved processes and working methods.
Communicate complex technical concepts and architectural decisions clearly.
Drive cross-functional collaboration and agreed improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience
System & Requirements Engineering
Proven experience in requirements analysis, systemisation, and development of complex systems.
Understanding of functional decomposition, modularity, and technical debt.
Ability to evaluate how architectural decisions affect long-term business flexibility and development costs.
Strong ability to connect technical solutions with business objectives.

Agile Methods & CI/CD
Strong practical knowledge of Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum.
Experience supporting transitions from waterfall to Agile delivery.
Hands-on experience establishing or improving CI/CD processes
Experience with product ownership or backlog management for CI/CD and development platform modernisation.

Architecture & Traceability
Experience establishing traceability between deployed systems, source code, tests, and engineering metrics.
Understanding of Software Factory processes, tools, and development environments.
Ability to evaluate and communicate technical and architectural alternatives.

Verification & Quality
Experience translating quality requirements into measurable criteria and quality gates.
Understanding of verification strategies, software quality metrics, and delivery performance.

Leadership & Communication
Extensive experience in cross-functional engineering or technical leadership roles.
Background in one or more of the following positions:
Scrum Master
Software Architect
Product Owner
Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
Ability to facilitate collaboration, guide teams, and drive organisational improvements.

Who Should Apply?
We are looking for professionals who combine strong business analysis and requirements engineering capabilities with practical knowledge of software architecture, Agile transformation, and CI/CD.
The ideal candidate can connect business value with technical decisions, understand the long-term impact of system architecture, and help engineering organisations establish measurable, traceable, and sustainable software development processes.
Experience working with complex or mission-critical software systems is particularly valuable.
How to Apply
Are you an experienced Software Factory Business Analyst, System Engineer, Product Owner, or Scrum Master looking for your next opportunity?
Submit your updated CV through the Hykmann careers portal:
🌐 https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Please highlight your experience in:
Requirements engineering and systemisation.
Software Factory development and modernisation.
Scrum and Agile transformation.
CI/CD implementation and optimisation.
System architecture and technical traceability.
Verification, quality metrics, and performance measurement.
Cross-functional engineering leadership.

When critical IT incidents occur, clear coordination and decisive action make all the difference. As Global Incident Manager, you lead the response to major and high-impact incidents, bringing the right people together to restore services quickly and minimize business impact.  
You join Service Management and work within the Service Stability area alongside Global Incident Managers and colleagues focused on Incident, Problem and Event Management. 
About the job 
You’re the central coordination point during major and critical IT incidents, creating structure, driving progress and ensuring clear communication, escalation and decision support. Your scope covers global Incident Management operations, including major incidents, escalation support and Cybersecurity Incident Management (CSIM) when assigned. Your focus is operational incident leadership, while using hands-on experience and lessons learned to continuously improve our ways of working.  
Job responsibilities 
Lead and coordinate the end-to-end response to P1, major and other high-impact incidents. 
Establish effective command and control, with clear responsibilities, action tracking and decision points. 
Bring together resolver teams, service providers, technical specialists and business stakeholders to drive incidents toward resolution. 
Remove blockers and escalate when service restoration, business continuity, security or regulatory targets are at risk. 
Provide timely and clear communication to operational teams, business stakeholders and leadership. 
Facilitate post-incident reviews, follow up lessons learned and improvement actions, monitor recurring issues and contribute to improvements in processes, tools and capabilities. 
Take part in on-call duties and respond to incidents outside normal business hours, according to the agreed operational model. 

Location 
The position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken. 
Your profile 
You’ve built solid experience in Incident Management or a similar operational IT field and know how to coordinate major incidents in complex environments. Working across multiple stakeholders comes naturally to you, and you combine operational IT knowledge with a structured approach to service management. 
Your background includes: 
Experience with IT service-management processes and tools in a global or multi-stakeholder environment. 
A relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience in IT operations, service management or a related field. 
ITIL Foundation or an equivalent service-management certification. 
Professional proficiency in written and spoken English. 

Experience in process improvement, governance, cybersecurity incident response or crisis management is beneficial. Advanced certification within ITIL, Incident Management, security, process management or crisis management, as well as additional relevant languages, are also considered an advantage. 
Being calm and decisive under pressure, you create clarity when situations are complex and moving quickly. You communicate clearly with technical, business and leadership audiences, take ownership and persistently drive incidents toward service restoration. You’re comfortable influencing others without formal authority while turning incidents and deviations into opportunities for learning.

Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options.  Are you intrigued? All about the role:

As aftermarket sales Product Owner, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining business processes to ensure efficiency and compliance for aftermarket sales and services. You will be part of the product team within IT EMEA/APAC, working cross-functionally with product, engineering and bunsiess owners to ensure that our products meet the needs of our customers and align with our business goals.

You will work closely with business stakeholders to define requirements for the core commerce platform, manage the sales backlog, monitor development team deliveries, and coordinate cross-functional dependencies with Contact Centers, Service Operations, Finance, Online Services, and B2B Operations.

 

What you'll do:

Provide guidance to engineering and commercial teams on process-related matters and foster a culture of process and product excellence.
Mirror Key Users (KU) in the markets and responsible for running KU forums. Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify process and product improvement opportunities.
Work with technical teams to ensure processes are supported by appropriate tools and systems.
Ensure processes facilitate smooth delivery of product features across the product areas.
Monitor product performance, business adoption and business & tech KPIs to implement corrective actions when necessary.
Consolidate the sales backlog across multiple product areas. Manage process-related tasks and prioritize improvements based on business impact.
Support with developing a roadmap for process enhancements to support organizational goals.
Create and update process documentation, analyse the requirments and transfer it into detailed requirement specification for development team, support commercial counterparts centrally and locally to drive adoption of standardized processes across the organization.

 

Who you are:

You have a strong understanding of cross-functional business processes, systems, and postpurchase operations, with knowledge of sales, service, and financial flows and have proven experience working in product team. You are a hands-on problem solver who can translate business needs into process improvements and solutions that drive commercial growth.

Qualifications:

To be successful in this role, we believe that you have good prioritization skills and the ability to go into details without losing focus of the bigger picture.
3+ years as Process Owner/Product Owner or similar role in digital solutions supporting aftermarket sales, service, finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
Strong product mindset and understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in Agile teams.
Proficiency in Jira and/or Github for managing product backlogs and sprints.
In-depth knowledge of aftermarket sales processes (sales orders, payments, invoicing, refunds) related to services, extended warranties, spares, consumables & accessories
Understanding of fulfillment and logistics processes, especially in the context of spare parts, consumables and accessories is a plus
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Curious, self motivated and problem solver
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills
In-depth knowledge of the sales & distribution and finance domain in SAP (e.g. SD/GL/AP) would be beneficial

 

 
Where you will be:

This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.
We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.
 

Benefits highlights:

Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
Comprehensive insurance coverage.
Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
Access to in-house sports facilities.

 
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
 
As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU WILL DO
As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.
You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.
You will:
Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.
WHO YOU ARE
You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.
We are looking for people with:
Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

WHO WE ARE
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
An example of our benefits:
25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.

JOIN US
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
This is a permanent position based in Stockholm, please send your CV in English as soon as possible.
*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Hunt Consulting is a reputable consultancy firm specialising in program and project
management, business development and executive management. Our clients include
international organisations and non-governmental organisations working to advance the sustainable use of natural resources worldwide. The work of the clients may include but is not limited to international collaboration, policy engagement, knowledge sharing, and capacity development.
The opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Program Manager to support
the development and implementation of international programmes and policy
initiatives related to sustainable resource governance.
The successful candidate will contribute to policy analysis, programme development, stakeholder engagement, and international cooperation efforts aimed at strengthening governance frameworks and supporting evidence-based
decision-making. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic international environment with governments, multilateral organisations, research institutions, NGOs, and private sector stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Support the design, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of international programmes and projects related to sustainable resource management. 
Conduct policy analysis and research on environmental governance issues at local, national, and international levels.
Engage with governments,international organisations, donors, and other stakeholders to advance programme objectives.
Build and maintain relationships with senior government officials, ministries, public     authorities, development agencies, and international partners.
Contribute to the development
of policy briefs, reports, technical papers, and knowledge products.
Organise and facilitate workshops, consultations, conferences, and multi-stakeholder dialogues.
Support fundraising efforts, including proposal development and donor reporting.
Monitor developments in international environmental and water policy and identify implications for programme activities.
Represent the organisation in external meetings, working groups, international forums, and professional networks as required.

Qualifications and Experience
Essential Requirements
Master's degree or higher in Environmental
Governance, Environmental Policy, International Development, Natural
Resource Management, or a closely related field.
Minimum eight (8) years of relevant professional experience in sustainable governance of natural resources or related fields.
Demonstrated experience working in the Global South with international environmental and sustainability policy processes.
Proven experience organising and hosting events at international conferences related to natural resource management.
Experience engaging with senior government officials, ministries, public authorities, intergovernmental organisations, and other high-level stakeholders.
Strong understanding of environmental governance, environmental policy, sustainable development, and international cooperation frameworks.
Experience working in Sweden with Swedish stakeholders.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong analytical, research, drafting, and report-writing skills.
Excellent interpersonal, stakeholder engagement, and facilitation skills.
Advanced computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office Suite and practical experience with SAP, Microsoft Project, or similar enterprise and project management systems.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively contributing to multinational and multidisciplinary teams.
Willingness and ability to undertake extensive international travel.

Desirable Qualifications
Additional language skills, particularly Spanish, Swedish, German, or other internationally relevant languages.
Experience working with international NGOs, UN organisations, development agencies, research institutions, or donor-funded programmes.
Experience in natural resource management approaches.
Knowledge of international environmental agreements and global sustainability frameworks.
Experience in programme management, monitoring and evaluation, donor reporting, and partnership development.

Personal attributes
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
Strong intercultural awareness and the ability to build effective relationships across diverse cultural, political, and institutional contexts.
Proven capacity to engage confidently with high-level decision makers and represent the organisation in international forums.
Excellent diplomatic,negotiation, and communication skills.
Strong project coordination and organisational abilities.
Initiative, adaptability, and a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
Sound judgement and discretion when handling sensitive issues and stakeholder relationships.
A strong commitment to sustainable development and environmental stewardship.

What We Offer
A unique opportunity to contribute to global efforts that strengthen sustainable development worldwide.
A dynamic and international work environment with engagement across governments, multilateral organisations, academia, civil society, and the private sector.
The opportunity to work with leading experts and decision makers in the fields of environmental governance, and sustainable development.
A competitive compensation and
benefits package commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Excellent opportunities for professional growth.
Exposure to high-level international policy processes, conferences, and strategic initiatives.
An inclusive, collaborative, and mission-driven organisational culture that values innovation,
diversity, and impact.

How to Apply
Interested candidates are invited to submit:
A cover letter outlining their suitability for the role.
A detailed CV in English.
Contact details for three professional references.

Applications should be submitted no later than dec 13 2026 to: Sales@Huntconsulting.se 
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Qualified candidates may be contacted for interviews prior to the application deadline. The organisation reserves the right to close the recruitment process once a suitable candidate has been identified.
Hunt Consulting AB is managing this recruitment. All applications will be treated with the utmost confidentiality. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Data Protection Notice (GDPR)
For questions regarding the processing and management of your personal data, please
contact Sales@Huntconsulting.se.

Ref. 4297Ö
We are looking for a warm, caring and experienced night nanny to become an important part of a lovely family in Östermalm. Two nannies will share the position, one covering daytime and one nighttime, working alternate weeks.
The family hopes to find someone with a genuine passion for children who can become like an extra mum to their little boy, providing love, security and stability.
The mother has an injury that limits her ability to lift and physically assist her son. A nanny must therefore always be present and available when he is with her, providing essential practical support.
About the Little Boy
He is a happy, affectionate, confident and energetic 4.5-year-old who loves tennis, football and cars. He enjoys playing, exploring and spending time with an engaged adult.
He attends nursery approximately 09:00–15:00 and is in good health. English is his main language, and the family would ideally like an English-speaking nanny to help maintain and develop his English.
Night Nanny – Responsibilities
He usually goes to bed around 20:00 and sleeps until 05:30–06:30, occasionally waking briefly.
Responsibilities include:
Being available and monitoring his wellbeing throughout the night.
Comforting and assisting him if he wakes.
Preparing breakfast, meals and snacks.
Completing morning routines and getting him ready for nursery.
Nursery drop-off and collection.
Playing and spending quality time together.
Supporting his interests and activities.
Packing his nursery bag.
Making beds and keeping his areas tidy.
Child-related laundry and ironing when needed.
Light household tasks, including tidying up and wiping kitchen surfaces.
Administering medication when required.

The nanny sleeps in a separate area with the child, away from the mother.
Working Schedule & Flexibility
The position involves 12-hour shifts every other week, averaging approximately 167 hours per month.
Reliability and consistency are essential. Occasional cover for the other nanny may be required in case of sickness. Both nannies are expected to work as a supportive team.
International Travel
The family travels internationally throughout the year, sometimes for 1–2 weeks or longer, and the nanny must be happy to accompany them.
During trips, extended working hours may be required, with time off in lieu afterwards. Both nannies may occasionally cover daytime and nighttime duties.
The family also has a second home abroad. A driving licence is not essential but would be an advantage.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who is:
Warm, loving, empathetic and genuinely passionate about children.
Experienced with young children.
Energetic, playful, calm and patient.
Emotionally intelligent and confident setting loving boundaries.
Reliable, responsible and trustworthy.
Flexible, proactive and helpful.
Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
Happy to travel internationally.
English- or Swedish-speaking.
Comfortable administering medication when required.

A Special Long-Term Opportunity
This is an opportunity to become a valued and trusted part of a warm family, building a close and lasting relationship with their little boy.
We are looking for someone who will genuinely care about his happiness and development and bring warmth, stability and positive energy into his everyday life.
If you are an experienced, caring and dependable nanny who would love to become part of this family, we would love to hear from you!

Reports to: Director

Role and Responsibilities
The Business Manager is responsible for the effective management, operation, development and administration of the school's Finance, HR, Payroll and Reception functions, ensuring efficient processes, sound financial management and compliance with applicable legislation, regulations and internal policies.
Finance and Financial Management
Overall responsibility for the school's financial management, including accounting, financial reporting, budgeting and financial projections.
Lead long-term financial and cash flow planning, and provide financial analysis and decision-making support to the Director, Senior Leadership Team  and the Board of Trustees.
Lead and coordinate the annual budget process and ongoing budget follow-up.
Ensure monthly reconciliations, financial monitoring and reporting.
Oversee year-end reconciliations, accruals, financial statements, closing procedures and external audits.
Establish, maintain and monitor effective internal controls and financial procedures.
Oversee procurement, purchasing, contract management and related administrative processes.

HR, Payroll and Personnel Administration
Oversee the school's HR, payroll and personnel administration functions, ensuring effective processes and compliance with applicable employment legislation, collective agreements and internal policies.
Ensure appropriate coordination of recruitment, employment matters, payroll administration and related personnel processes.

Reception and Administrative Services
Oversee the operation and development of Reception, ensuring effective day-to-day service and appropriate administrative support to the school community.

Policies, Governance and Compliance
Develop, implement and maintain policies, guidelines and procedures within the department's areas of responsibility.
Manage relevant cases, investigations and consultation processes relating to Finance, HR, Payroll and Reception.
Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, regulatory requirements and internal governance frameworks.

Leadership and Management
Lead and manage the Finance, Payroll, HR and Reception teams.
Lead the department, including planning, organising, prioritising and allocating work, setting objectives and following up on performance and results.
Manage, support and develop departmental staff, promoting collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
Drive the development and improvement of departmental processes, systems and ways of working.
Exercise leadership in accordance with Swedish employment legislation, workplace practices and expectations of managers, recognising that collaboration, open dialogue and employee participation are integral to how leadership is expected to be practised. Foster an inclusive and respectful working environment where employees are encouraged to contribute, share perspectives and take an active part in matters affecting their work.

External Relations and Organisational Responsibilities
Represent the school in external meetings, professional forums and networks within the areas of responsibility.
Contribute as a member of the School´s Senior Leadership Team, supporting strategic planning, decision-making and the overall development of the school.
Report to the School Director.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Business Administration or a related field.
Extensive knowledge of accounting, financial closing processes and financial reporting.
Strong analytical skills and experience in business and operational performance management.
The ability to translate financial information into actionable recommendations and well-founded decision-making support.
A solid understanding of profitability analysis, and cash flow
A good understanding of HR and Payroll processes.
Good verbal and written communication in English and Swedish. 

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of: a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our locations in central Stockholm are easily accessible by public transportation.
Contract
Employment Type: Permanent Administrative Position (with a six-month probationary period)
Employment Rate: 100%
Start Date: February 2027, or on another date as mutually agreed

Salary
Individually negotiated

Application
Last day for applications: November 30, 2026 (the interview process can start earlier).
We only accept applications in English and from qualified candidates.
Please send a letter of interest and your CV to application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “Business Manager”.
Please note that, in order to work at SIS, you must hold a valid work permit or be an EU citizen.
SIS reserves the right to close the application process at any time once a suitable candidate is found and accepts the position.

We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started. 
At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it. 
At Husqvarna Group, within Global Aftermarket Operations P&A, our Supply & Inventory Planning team ensures that products flow efficiently from our factories and external suppliers to our sales companies and distributors. Our mission is to provide customers with the right products, at the right time, while maintaining capital efficiency and operational excellence. 
We are now looking for a Supply & Inventory Planner to join our team in Huskvarna. In this role, you will act as a key interface between our product categories, factories, suppliers, and sales companies. You will collaborate closely with experienced team members in a dynamic, supportive, and results-driven environment, where teamwork and proactive problem-solving are essential for success. 
We are expanding our team and have both permanent and fixed-term opportunities available - making this a great time to join us. 
Key responsibilities 
Own your assortments delivery performance from our state-of-the-art distribution center in Stigamo, as well as our Regional Distribution Centers, meeting targets to exceed customer expectations. 
Be the link between product categories, sales companies, factories, and suppliers, using forecasts from our demand team to secure availability and efficient supply chain operations. 
Place orders and proactively monitor deliveries to ensure timely fulfillment. 
Pro-actively monitor supply risks, mitigate and escalate internally & externally. 
Balance availability and capital efficiency by managing inventory and driving the elimination of slow-moving articles within your assortment 
Maintain and continuously improve planning parameters and master data, including article setup and registration, to ensure accurate planning and execution. 
Be an active  part in product launches and phase-outs and support resolving quality issues. 
Drive improvements and play an active role in organizational change initiatives. 

Who we are looking for 
You are a structured, analytical, and driven problem solver who thrives in a collaborative environment. You demonstrate strong personal leadership traits, such as initiative, accountability, and adaptability, and you value the potential for continuous improvement and positive change. You are service-minded, flexible, and able to manage multiple stakeholders while balancing competing priorities. 
Your skills and background 
Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken. 
University degree in logistics, economics, or equivalent professional experience. 

You will be welcomed into a company and a culture that values collaboration, personal leadership, and continuous improvement. Whether you have recently graduated or already gained some relevant experience, we offer an opportunity to build your skills and grow within our organisation. You do not need to have all the answers from day one; what matters is your curiosity, willingness to learn, and motivation to contribute. 
Location: 
This position will be placed in Huskvarna, Sweden. We believe in a dynamic, energized workplace and day-to-day collaboration, and we meet in the office at least 4 days a week (80%). 
Your application 
Please submit your application in English as soon as possible as we review applications on an ongoing basis. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations. 
For questions about the role, reach out to hiring manager Samuel Spjuth, at samuel.spjuth@husqvarnagroup.com.  
For questions about the recruitment process, reach out to Talent Acquisition Partner Nina Hallin at nina.hallin@husqvarnagroup.com.  
We look forward to hearing from you!  
Processing of personal data 
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. 
For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice. 
Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.     
Our culture is built on three core themes:   
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities. 
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.   
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.   

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Test Fleet Engineer – Expert | Vehicle Fleet Management & Test Operations
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Test Engineer – Expert (Test Fleet Engineer)
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience
Language: English
Engagement: IT Consulting Assignment
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Test Fleet Engineer at Expert level to support advanced vehicle testing and engineering operations.
In this role, you will take responsibility for ensuring maximum availability and utilization of test vehicles throughout their lifecycle. You will work closely with project management, engineering teams, testing departments, workshops and external suppliers to ensure that vehicles are maintained, prepared and available for their planned test activities.
The position combines vehicle fleet management, technical coordination, project planning, logistics, problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
1. Test Fleet Management & Vehicle Uptime
Ensure maximum uptime and availability of the complete test vehicle fleet.
Act as the first point of support for vehicle uptime and coordinate support for field-test vehicles.
Proactively identify and resolve issues affecting vehicle availability.
Coordinate activities during unplanned vehicle stops, including workshop resources and necessary repairs.
Monitor vehicle utilization and identify opportunities to improve fleet efficiency.
Plan and coordinate vehicle maintenance between testing and loan periods.

2. Workshop & Technical Coordination
Coordinate internal and external workshop resources to ensure timely vehicle repairs and maintenance.
Identify, order and manage spare parts, materials and required services.
Arrange towing and special transportation between different testing locations.
Coordinate vehicle readiness and ensure appropriate documentation before transportation.
Manage external supplier activities and follow up on related invoices.
Ensure that vehicle modifications, updates and damages are properly documented.

3. Fleet Optimization & Project Coordination
Analyse individual vehicle and overall fleet utilization.
Optimize the number of vehicles required to support ongoing testing activities.
Coordinate timely divestment of vehicles to optimize fleet size and reduce unnecessary capital tied up in vehicles.
Participate in project meetings and lead actions related to vehicle uptime and fleet optimization.
Communicate requirements, provide recommendations and share knowledge with relevant stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities meet established test fleet requirements.

4. Logistics & International Transportation
Plan and coordinate vehicle transportation between testing facilities.
Organize special transport and towing requirements.
Coordinate resources and transportation documentation for vehicle export and import outside the EU.
Ensure vehicles are properly prepared and documented before transportation.

5. Continuous Improvement
Identify and implement improvements to fleet management processes and operating procedures.
Develop efficient methods to improve vehicle availability and utilization.
Document processes, share knowledge and contribute to long-term operational improvements.
Support engineering teams in achieving testing objectives through effective fleet planning and coordination.

Required Skills & Experience
Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in test engineering, vehicle operations, fleet management or related automotive engineering activities.
Strong understanding of vehicle systems and automotive product development.
Experience in vehicle fleet coordination, testing operations or technical project management.
Proven ability to manage multiple activities and coordinate different stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Experience coordinating workshops, repairs, maintenance and external suppliers.
Ability to analyse vehicle utilization and identify opportunities for operational optimization.
Good understanding of vehicle transportation and logistics processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience
Experience with the following systems and tools will be an advantage:
PROTOM
KOLA
GLORIA
IMPACT
BOSS

Additional experience in international vehicle transportation, customs-related documentation, test fleet lifecycle management and automotive project coordination is highly beneficial.
What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a senior engineering professional who can take ownership of vehicle fleet operations and proactively ensure that test vehicles are available, maintained and ready for planned testing activities.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, coordination and problem-solving capabilities, together with the ability to influence stakeholders, manage complex operational challenges and drive continuous improvements.
At expert level, you should also be comfortable mentoring colleagues, sharing technical knowledge and acting as a trusted point of contact for complex operational and technical matters.
Interested in This Opportunity?
Are you an experienced automotive professional with a background in test fleet management, vehicle operations or engineering coordination?
We would be happy to hear from you!
Apply directly through our careers page:
🌐 https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB

Looking for a flexible part-time job alongside your studies or other commitments? Join Assessio's Global Support team and gain valuable experience in customer support, HR technology, and digital assessment solutions.
At Assessio, we believe in ZERO TALENT WASTE – helping organizations identify, develop, and make the most of people's potential.
We're looking for a proactive, service-minded, and Dutch-speaking Customer Support Agent to join our Global Support team on a part-time basis.
Whether you're a university student looking to gain professional experience or someone seeking a long-term part-time opportunity, this could be a great fit.
About the Role
As a Part-Time Customer Support Agent at Assessio, you'll play an important role in delivering an excellent customer experience to our international clients.
You'll be part of our Global Support team, working closely with supportive, motivated colleagues who enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, and having fun together.
Your main responsibility will be to help customers navigate our digital platforms, answer questions, and resolve issues efficiently and professionally.
You'll receive training in our products, systems, and support processes, giving you the opportunity to build valuable skills in customer service, HR technology, and SaaS-based solutions.
Working Hours & Availability

Part-time position: 20 hours per week

Fixed working hours: Thursdays and Fridays, 13:00–17:30

Remaining 11 hours scheduled flexibly by agreement

We're looking for someone interested in a long-term opportunity
